language_policy: report top language and uncertainty; route rather than assume non-English is invalid
toxicity_policy: main toxicity score >=0.5 is provisional flag, not calibrated rejection; all class scores saved
duplicate_policy: exact raw and NFKC+casefold+whitespace normalized matching; all 630 pairs checked for exact word-trigram Jaccard >=0.8, >=5 words each; MinHash128 seed42 estimate recorded, not used to discard pairs
long_review_policy: Detoxify original whole-review predict if <=512 tokens including special tokens; otherwise overlapping 400-token windows stride272, per-label maximum; no tail discarded
gate_comparison: join archived v5 decisions by review ID and identical text; do not rerun or modify gate
